The manifest already includes all eight nested capacity include inputs; independent inspection and readback found no missing include provenance.

Review and freeze the executable runner and coverage checks before any model run; this receipt evaluates the written run contract and does not certify an absent runner.

Apply the same gates to the remaining eight pairs, rehash all source/build/input/output evidence, and rerun the unchanged particle audit. No model interpretation or parameter acceptance before all18 lanes pass.
